text: それで　よごすの　いや　だから　おうちに　かざるわ！

structure.en: getting it dirty by doing that

structure.jp: おうちに　かざるわ！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. The は or が after it is dropped here. よごすの = 'getting it dirty'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives it as the reason for what comes next. いや　だから = 'I'd hate that, so'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end adds soft feeling to a statement and here sounds feminine. かざるわ = 'I'll put it on display'.
